cultural.vision_reason: Qajar-style painted album page depicting a young woman in Persian costume (jacket, skirt, tall cap with feather and jewel, veil), matching the album's stated theme of Persian costumes — a traditional court/album painting of the culture itself.

physical.title: album; painting
physical.summary:
Portrait of a young woman; single-page painting mounted on album folio. A young woman stands holding a bouquet of yellow and blue flowers and a pink rose in her right hand and a posey of narcissus in her left. She wears an orange blouse under a green jacket fastened at the waist and a pink skirt. Her headdress consists of a feather and a jewel ornament, a yellow and blue striped cap and a lavender flowered veil fastened under her chin. Album contains 19 paintings of Persian costumes.
Ink and opaque watercolour on paper. Album bound in green leather with gold gilt trim, with pages of gold trim. Includes loose letter (in French) on thin blue paper describing contents and addressed to recipient.
